messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Adele Morrison <adele.morrison@storiq.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@storiq.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & proposed commitment plan — product fit discovery (Storiq)

Hi Adele / Marcus,

Thanks again for the 45-minute discovery earlier today — really helpful to understand where Storiq is trying to take personalization in the mobile app. Quick recap and a draft commitment plan so we can align on next steps. I attached an editable MPA (storiq-mpa-v1.xlsx).

Key pain points we heard
- Inference latency on recommendation scoring > 300ms at peak, causing dropped personalization flows.
- Unpredictable unit cost when traffic spikes during promos — team needs clearer cost SLOs.
- Limited observability into per-model token costs and tail latencies (esp. batch vs single-item paths).

Business goals (next 90 days)
1) Reduce p95 latency for recommendation calls below 120ms for 95% of traffic.
2) Demonstrate a 30% decrease in cost-per-recommendation using batching + caching under a pilot workload.
3) Ship model-level traces into your telemetry stack and set up alerting for regression.

Proposed Mutual Commitment (draft milestones)
- Milestone A (by 2027-05-17): Pilot readiness — data ingest, test keys, baseline perf measurements (owners: Storiq Eng: Marcus; Redwood AE: Nikhil).
- Milestone B (by 2027-05-31): Alpha pilot — live traffic sample (10% traffic), initial latency/cost dashboard (owners: Marcus; Redwood Solutions: Laura).
- Milestone C (by 2027-06-21): Pilot evaluation & decision — performance vs SLOs, cost analysis, go/no-go for expanded rollout (owners: Storiq PM: Adele; Redwood CS: Ben).

Asks from you
1) Confirm procurement/contract timeline and the person who owns it.
2) Share security contact for a short questionnaire (we usually need a SOC2 + network diagram request).
3) Confirm whether pilot can use a non-prod dataset with realistic traffic (we can ingest sample if needed).

Next steps
- I can update the attached MPA with any date/owner changes and circulate a final PDF for signatures.
- Tentative tech sync with Laura & Marcus week of 2027-05-10 — does Tuesday 5/11 or Wednesday 5/12 morning PT work?

Attachments: storiq-mpa-v1.xlsx (MPA draft), storiq-procurement-timeline.docx (procurement notes)

Thanks — excited to map this out.

—
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nsharma@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks, Nikhil — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement: our PM and procurement team are aligned on a June procurement window; legal will need ~2 weeks for a standard SaaS Addendum. Primary procurement lead is Tara Bloom (tara.bloom@storiq.com).
2) Security: please loop in security@storiq.com for the questionnaire — I'll copy them on the next message.
3) Pilot scope: we can start with a non-prod traffic replay environment that mirrors peak traffic (we'll provide a 72-hr sample).

Regarding the milestones — dates look sensible. Can you add a line item for an SLA exception review if we need lower p99 latencies? Also: budget is sensitive; we need an estimator that shows delta vs current infra spend for the expected sample traffic.

Happy to do the tech sync — 5/11 AM PT works for Marcus and me. Can Laura include a short test plan so we can prepare logins and sample data?

Adele
